settings.heading: Shorter path to acceptance
settings.text: Patients decide on what they can see. A preview of their own face makes aligners, veneers or whitening concrete instead of abstract.

settings.heading: Honest expectations
settings.text: Results stay natural and are clearly labelled as visualisations — never a clinical promise. Fewer surprises, fewer difficult conversations later.

settings.heading: Nothing to install at the practice
settings.text: Runs on any iPhone. No scanner, no software licence, no onboarding project. Buy credits, start today.

settings.heading: Take the photo during intake
settings.text: A relaxed smile under normal operatory light is enough.

settings.heading: Pick the treatment you're proposing
settings.text: Aligner progress, veneers upgrade or whitening boost — one tap.

settings.heading: Compare, animate, share
settings.text: Before/after side by side, optional video, sent to the patient to discuss at home.

settings.label: Privacy
settings.text: Patient photos remain private and are never shared without permission. Processed under EU law by CC Lab Technology Ltd., Dublin.

settings.label: Scope
settings.text: Visualisation and inspiration only. Toothfairy™ AI does not diagnose, plan or replace clinical judgement — and says so to the patient.

settings.label: Built by
settings.text: Orthoclear — the team behind the Toothfairy™ patient app used throughout aligner treatment. Dental first, AI second.
